name: Carpenter's goods

product.purpose: Prepare Etsy and Shopify product drafts and track agreed commissions from owner-exported sales.
product.publication: Manual publication only after owner approval; no platform write connector is used.
product.billing: Commission per sale, with the rate agreed in writing with the carpenter.

your_steps.title: Agree the commission in writing
your_steps.when: Before tracking sales or collecting commission
your_steps.detail: Agree the rate and eligible sale amount with the carpenter, keep the written agreement, then use that rate when running the commission tracker. Glacier does not sign it.

your_steps.title: Review and publish the first listing
your_steps.detail: Review the photos, facts, comparable sales and price, then approve and manually publish in the Etsy shop and Shopify site. Glacier does not create accounts or publish listings.

your_steps.title: Provide product and sales records
your_steps.when: When preparing a listing or commission summary
your_steps.detail: Save product facts and local photo paths under the venture's incoming folder, add at least three source-linked completed-sale comparisons, and export paid order records for commission tracking.

launch_gates: Owner agrees commission terms in writing with the carpenter.
Owner approves the first product listing before manual publication.
Any paid production or order is approved by the owner.
